items.title: 1990年代末〜2000年代の日本ゲーム文化を収めた写真300点超が無料公開。当時のTGS，AMショーなどの模様に加えて，秋葉原の風景も確認できる
items.summary: ゲーム史の保存や研究に取り組む米国の非営利団体・VideoGameHistoryFoundation（VGHF）は2026年10月21日，写真コレクション「ColinWilliamsonPhotographyCollection」をオンラインアーカイブで公開した。1990年代末〜2000年代の日本のゲームイベントや街の風景などを収めた300点超の写真を無料で閲覧できる。

zh.title: 超过 300 张描绘 20 世纪 90 年代末至 2000 年代日本游戏文化的照片可免费获取。除了当时的TGS和AM秀之外，还可以看到秋叶原的风景。
zh.summary: 2026 年 10 月 21 日，致力于保存和研究游戏历史的美国非营利组织 VideoGameHistoryFoundation (VGHF) 在其在线档案中发布了其照片集“ColinWilliamsonPhotographyCollection”。您可以免费查看 300 多张 20 世纪 90 年代末至 2000 年代日本游戏活动和城市场景的照片。

en.title: Over 300 photos depicting Japanese game culture from the late 1990s to the 2000s are available for free. In addition to the TGS and AM shows from that time, you can also see the scenery of Akihabara.
en.summary: On October 21, 2026, the VideoGameHistoryFoundation (VGHF), an American non-profit organization that works to preserve and research game history, released its photo collection ``ColinWilliamsonPhotographyCollection'' on its online archive. You can view over 300 photos of Japanese gaming events and city scenes from the late 1990s to 2000s for free.

en.title: Eternal Summer Interview: What do the most radical successors to the spirit of Disco Elysium think?
en.summary: In 2024, Summer Eternal, a studio claiming that "the core members come from the original "Disco Elysium" writing team, announced its establishment. Prior to this, after the key members of ZA/UM who created "Disco Elysium" were scattered, news surrounding their whereabouts and which product was the true spiritual sequel to "Disco Elysium" once filled the players' horizons. In the eyes of "Disco Elysium" players, the members who left have formed at least four teams, including Red Info, Longdue Games and Dark Math Game. The style of Summer Eternal is more prominent, even radical. In addition to making games, they directly used the almost idealized form of "no executives, only artists" and "everything is shared by creators and players" to respond to those issues about capital and creation back then.
